svg.text: The cost model on the 12 new streams: predicted seconds against measured
(a) unit cost, one price per operation
(b) priced by kind, and by table size against L3
Fitted on M1D05's 3 streams, drawn on M1D07's 12, which no coefficient saw (M1D09). Clock winner named: unit cost 21 of 64 cells, (b) 64 of 64.
Median error 70.1% and 22.9%. The table-size term adds nothing over pricing by kind, and (b) puts WJ at about a fifth of its time. In (a), 33 predictions under 0.03 s sit on the floor.
